name: Fitness Coach
description: A personal coach that plans your workouts and meals, logs what you eat, drink and do, and keeps a fitness dashboard current, with steps, sleep and PAI from a connected tracker
author: flock

examplePrompts: I had two eggs and toast for breakfast
How am I doing on protein this week?
Show me how to do a dead bug

skills.description: Sync steps, calories, sleep, workouts, weight and PAI from a Zepp / Amazfit watch

accountRequirement.setupGuide: Sign in to your Zepp account

setupChecklist.label: Identity configured
setupChecklist.description: Set a name and avatar for your coach

setupChecklist.label: Coach instructions set
setupChecklist.description: The instructions define how your coach works with you

setupChecklist.label: Connect a fitness tracker (optional)
setupChecklist.description: Connect Zepp so steps, sleep, weight and PAI arrive on their own. Without one, log by chat.
